correctness.rationale: For iid uniform eccentric anomaly points on ellipse (Lcos theta,sin theta), affine-invariant center-enclosure probability is exactly 1/4 by circular gap criterion. Order x-coordinates; the middle-vertex acute dot product implies L^2 g1 g2<4, forcing one near-vertical opposite-sine-branch pair outside a negligible triple-collision corner. On compact separated c,d parameters its allowable delta width is 4(1-c^2)/(L^2 |d-c|); joint origin enclosure is cd<0 and |c|<|d|. The arcsine-coordinate Jacobian cancels 1-c^2, giving limit 3/pi^3 times J, where J=4 int_0^1 dr/sqrt(1-r^2) int_0^r du/(u+r)=2pi log2, hence coefficient 6log2/pi^2=0.421382956636... . Dominated truncation kernel 1/[(r+u)sqrt(1-r^2)] controls origin and endpoints; the same bounds for bounded marks yield L1 density and conditional total variation. Substitution u=rv factorizes independent R arcsine and U density 1/((1+u)log2). The known marginal P(acute)~12 logL/(pi^2 L^2) gives P(center|acute)~log2/(2logL). Independent exact kernel normalization and mark means confirmed; no finite simulation was treated as proof.
